name: Psych-ADR
description: Psych-ADR is a benchmark and evaluation framework designed to assess large language models' performance in detecting adverse drug reactions related to psychiatric medications and providing expert-aligned harm reduction strategies.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark from the psychiatric safety/healthcare LLM literature, with limited but growing attention rather than broad community adoption.
notes: Focuses on strategy-driven tasks in high-risk domains; highlights LLMs' struggles with nuanced ADR understanding and alignment with expert strategies.
